name: Lower Merion Youth Firefighter Camp
street_address: McMoran Park, 154 Mary Waters Ford Road
description_short: One week half day camp for ages 8 to 13 with the Lower Merion Fire Department at McMoran Park. Kids learn fire safety and prevention and a firefighter's daily work through short lessons and hands on drills like extinguisher training, hazmat and search and rescue.
notes: 2026 fee: non-residents $180, Lower Merion residents $150. Limited to 24 participants. Run with the Lower Merion Fire Department. 2027 not yet posted.
